worlds.selection: Deterministically sample 47 public rows at or before the pivot with all four A cue rows (and for cold all four B cue rows) included; final 48th is chosen pivot action. Include public original physical timestamp in each selected row; no hidden truth, off-trace states, unchosen factual return, or unseen future. This preserves a 224-tick world and cold latency, but does NOT measure 224 recurrent model steps.
worlds.observation: Use original R85 physically realized world constructor and rollout with fresh R86 seeded world source; random role binding for four A and four B signed factors, noisy public probe cue, hidden A parity; original A law is current at both intervention choices. OOD changes probe schedules, pivot clocks and multiplies observation/reward innovations by 1.35. OOD structural shift is narrower than transfer to entirely new physics.
worlds.FIT_labels: One private seeded uniformly randomized legal selected action CALIBRATE or EXPLOIT_POS and only its realized 9-step physical reward, no pair-branch labels, hidden signs, oracle, parity-rule targets, or privileged future data.
worlds.first_use: All five complete fixed optimizer training before generating independent DEV/OOD paired evaluator-only interventions. No scored panels touched by unit tests or model selection. Never access R85 calibration, R85 sealed or R84 scored panels.
